title: Turn a Reading into a Study Quiz with GitHub Copilot
facebook: Stuck with a pile of reading to study? Here's a simple trick: paste any article into GitHub Copilot, ask for practice questions, then check your answers against the original text. Takes about 10 minutes and actually helps you remember what you read. https://aiworldhq.com/article/turn-a-reading-into-a-study-quiz-with-github-copilot #StudyTips #AIForLearning
